flawed_step: The universal claim fails for the Horton graph.
counterexample: The Horton graph is a finite simple graph with 96 vertices and 144 edges. It is cubic, bipartite (with two parts of 48 vertices each), and 3-connected, but it has no Hamiltonian cycle.
assessment_summary: The Horton graph satisfies every hypothesis and violates the conclusion, so the statement is false.
